verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents an official Browse CLI that lets agents work in the terminal, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. The evidence only establishes that the CLI exists and what it is for; it says little about its commands or depth. Missing for 10: details of CLI commands and coverage (sessions, auth, install), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
